The structure of TbMg2Ni3 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a 24-atom unit cell (Tb4Mg8Ni12) and five independent Wyckoff orbits. CrystalNN geometry-only analysis shows Mg, Ni, and Tb centers each with 12 geometric neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements, with Ni–Ni distances spanning roughly 2.54–2.65 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Mg- and Ni-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, as well as among like-centered polyhedra.
